title: A planned check that builds a sandbox removes it, since land and the review rerun every sibling check
goal: The kb-sprint plan step says a check that builds a sandbox or clone (a multi or repro instance) removes everything it made in a finally, clones outside its temp dir included, since land's siblings step and the review's done rerun each done item's checks (SP-5y4ut64g close: about 110 multi sandboxes of 1.3 GB from the checks filled the disk; ST-y4z54l3q's landing stopped on ENOSPC at its siblings step after 415 s).

run:
import sys
t = open(".claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
step = t[t.index("## plan"):t.index("## start")]
sys.exit(0 if "sandbox" in step and "finally" in step else 1)
